doc.name: C — character sheet, forest fire lookout, near-future, rendered as stop-motion puppet, 5 panels

config.text:
CONCEPT BRIEF — edit before running.
Character concept: forest fire lookout, near-future, rendered as stop-motion puppet
World / era: [one line]
Silhouette keywords: [three words]
Palette: [three colours]
Signature prop: [one object]
Age / build: [one line]
Sheet output: 5 panels, identical character across all of them.
forest fire lookout, near-future, rendered as stop-motion puppet concept art moodboard, near-monochrome, corrugated metal
STAGE 1 — concept brief drives a scraped moodboard; the randomiser feeds one board image in as style reference.
STAGE 2 — one panel per turnaround angle. Design lock text is restated in every panel prompt.

config.system_prompt:
You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'forest fire lookout, near-future, rendered as stop-motion puppet'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias. Lighting reference: bare-bulb specular light producing tight, hot speculars.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'forest fire lookout, near-future, rendered as stop-motion puppet'.

PANEL. This branch renders the front orthographic: dead-on frontal, T-pose neutral, full figure.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even tungsten practicals in frame carrying the warm layer, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — wet river stone, ribbed fluted glass and others — with their wear state, and grade to a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
